summary: Istanbul Kosusu endless runner MVP tested end-to-end (backend + frontend web preview, 390x844). Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass covering players CRUD, nickname validation (422 for <2 chars), $max high_score + $inc coins/runs on run submit, bidirectional friendships with soft-delete + re-add, self-add 400, unknown-code 404, duplicate 409, and global leaderboard sorted desc with rank + is_me. Frontend: main menu renders over 3D canvas (Turkish UI, Istanbul street scene), menu-play-button starts game, HUD elements all appear, tutorial overlay dismisses, score ticks up, keyboard inputs accepted, pause-sheet opens with resume + home buttons and resume works. Player crashes into obstacle, game-over-sheet shows score/coins/distance/best + new-record-badge on first run; home button returns to menu with updated menu-best. Leaderboard: profile card shows 6-char friend_code, Local/Friends/Global tabs render, invalid friend_code shows 'Bu kodla bir oyuncu bulunamadı', valid code (seeded TEST_Friend PNM2TN) adds friend with rank-row + remove button, global tab lists ranked players. Settings: nickname-input + save PATCHes the backend (verified 200 + persisted body), menu-nickname updates immediately and after reload; haptics switch and reset-tutorial clickable; close returns to menu. No deprecated expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) detected. Minor console warnings only (textShadow* and pointerEvents deprecations from upstream RN web + benign WebGL GPU stall warnings).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'textShadow'. Likely originates from react-native-web; low impact but worth cleaning up any custom styles that set textShadowColor/Offset/Radius separately.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Search components (likely overlays/tutorial) using pointerEvents prop and move it under style.

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated pointerEvents prop usages with style.pointerEvents; use consolidated textShadow style instead of textShadow* individual props to silence RN web warnings.
Optional: pytest.ini forces -p no:xdist for this suite because tests share state across classes via pytest.player_a; if main agent wants parallel execution, convert to session-scoped fixtures.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py excludes Mongo _id correctly via from_mongo validator (BeforeValidator str()).
All env vars read via os.environ[...] with no defaults (fails fast).
Add friend upsert logic properly reactivates soft-deleted friendships (verified by test_remove_and_readd).
Global leaderboard filters high_score>0 so freshly created players don't pollute rankings (verified).
seed_data_creation: Created test players during backend tests (prefixed TEST_). Separately created TEST_Friend (friend_code PNM2TN, high_score 9500) via curl to seed a friend for frontend friend-add testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://run-forever-31.preview.emergentagent.com. Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v -p no:xdist` for regression. For frontend friend-add testing, create a fresh player via POST /api/players and submit a run so they appear on leaderboards; then use their 6-char friend_code in settings or leaderboard friend input. Localstorage holds player_id/nickname/local high scores; a fresh Playwright context creates a new auto-nickname profile Koşucu####. The game auto-pauses on navigation away from game screen.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found; all 16 backend tests + 6 frontend flows (menu render, play+HUD, pause/resume, crash+game-over+record, leaderboard tabs+friend add/remove+invalid-code error, settings nickname save+persist) passed.
